content: XML Schema production rule: xsd:attribute 57 of 90  AUTOSAR CONFIDENTIAL  Document ID 122: AUTOSAR_TPS_XMLSchemaProductionRules AUTOSAR XML Schema Production Rules AUTOSAR CP R19-11 Applies to: Property Precondition: xml.attribute=true upper multiplicity of property = 1 Target pattern: <xsd:attribute name= "<%=xmlName%>" type= "<%=typeXmlNsPrefix %>:<%=typeXmlName%>" <% if lowerMultiplicity > 0 { %> use="required" <% } else { %> use="optional" <% } %> /> Description: An xsd:attribute is created for each property with the tagged value ' xml.attribute=true '. The name of the xsd:attribute is defined by the XML name of the represented property. If the lower multiplicity of the property is bigger than 0 then the use of the attribute is required, otherwise it is optional. UML example: See Figure 5.11. XML schema example: <xsd:attribute name= "UUID" type= "xsd:string" use= "optional" /> XML instance example: <... UUID= "12343-23342-12345-2333" />
